correctness.rationale: The proof starts from the published if-and-only-if family classification and checks every family dimension. The linear families have exact rational equation ranks; \(I_{18}\) is a nonzero hypersurface in a four-plane; \(I_{19}\) and \(I_{20}\) are two-parameter nonzero charts; and \(I_{21}\) is finite over its two nonzero cubic coordinates. The tangent-space equality follows in both directions: the common equations force \(T_0\) into a twelve-plane, while the tangent spaces of the complementary six-planes \(I_{01}\) and \(I_{02}\) span that entire plane. The packaged exact-rational checker reproduces the finite rank steps.

value.rationale: Dimension, codimension, and tangent excess are natural invariants of a newly completed center/linearizability classification. The result shows that weakly persistent isochronicity is globally codimension eight yet only codimension two at first order at the linear system, explaining why low-order linear parameter tests substantially under-detect the actual constraints. This is structural information about the full classified locus rather than a renamed family or an arbitrary parameter slice.
